content: I will create the implementation plan to outline the database synchronization details. I will specify how restaurants, gallery images, menu categories, and menu items will be saved to Supabase, how we will prevent duplicates in the admin list, and how we will extract coordinates from Google Maps URLs.
thinking:
**Defining Restaurant Profiles**

I've established that public restaurant profile pages will follow the `/restaurant/:restaurantId` structure, rendered by `RestaurantProfilePublic`. Using the Supabase UUID (synced ID) will allow proper loading of the public profile via `fetchPublicRestaurantById`.


**Verifying Sync Logic**

I'm now integrating Supabase sync verification within `ExportedRestaurants.tsx`. I've added code to check which imported restaurants (IDs starting with 'scraped-') are synced. This uses a Supabase batch query with a deterministic UUID derived from the restaurant ID. The `syncedIds` state, managed with a `Set`, will hold the synced restaurant IDs. I've also added the `getDeterministicUUID` function.


**Refining Sync Function**

I've decided to export `getDeterministicUUID` from `useAdminRestaurants.ts` for cleaner, shared code. I am now working on a `handleSyncRestaurant` function in `ExportedRestaurants.tsx`, including UUID extraction and data preparation. The upsert logic into the `restaurants` table is next. This function cleans the phone number and address, extracts coordinates, and builds a payload for upserting, to avoid code duplication and improve maintainability and shareability.


**Implementing Menu Sync**

I'm now focusing on syncing menu data with Supabase. After a restaurant upsert, I'm checking for existing menu categories. If present, I'll delete existing categories and items. Then, I'll insert new categories, mapping them to their corresponding items, and insert those items. Lastly, I am syncing gallery images, by deleting any existing images before inserting new gallery entries.


**Implementing Parallel Sync**

I'm now implementing `handleSyncAll` to sync all restaurants. I'll iterate through the restaurant list, displaying real-time progress for each sync attempt using `syncingStatus`. Error handling is included. I've also defined `syncSingleToSupabase` as a reusable helper. Finally, I'm noting the implementation plan.

"# Plano de Implementação: Sincronização de Restaurantes e Cardápios com Supabase

Este plano detalha a implementação do recurso para persistir e sincronizar os dados dos restaurantes importados (coletados via Google Maps) e seus respectivos cardápios estruturados diretamente no banco de dados do Supabase.

## User Review Required

> [!NOTE]
> A sincronização será realizada sob demanda no painel de administração. O administrador poderá sincronizar os restaurantes individualmente ou em lote (todos).

> [!WARNING]
> Ao sincronizar um restaurante, as categorias de cardápio e pratos anteriores deste restaurante no Supabase serão removidos e recriados com a versão atual estruturada localmente para manter a consistência com o cardápio raspado.

#### [MODIFY] [useAdminRestaurants.ts](file:///c:/Users/meuno/Downloads/dazzling-axolotl-crawl-main/dazzling-axolotl-crawl-main/src/hooks/useAdminRestaurants.ts)

- **Exportar `getDeterministicUUID`**: Tornar esta função pública para que possamos utilizá-la em outros componentes para mapear IDs locais do tipo `scraped-...` para UUIDs do Supabase de forma consistente.
- **Evitar Duplicados no Admin**: Corrigir a lógica de mesclagem na linha 181 para verificar tanto o ID local quanto o UUID correspondente no banco. Se o restaurante já existir no Supabase, a versão local não deve ser duplicada na lista geral.

---
